Ming: quick notes from a small bring-up: speculative-decoder prototype on nova-13b quant variants. dumping bench + immediate theory.
Omar: short summary please
Ming: setup: cheap-prefix (q4a) -> accurate-hot (q8_base) fallback. policy = token-entropy-threshold + entity-trigger. goal = 2x token throughput for chat while keeping EM drop <1pp.
Priya: what did you run it on?
Ming: local perf box (8xA10G profile), ctx=3072, batch=12. measured tokens/sec +1.85x, median latency -30% (18ms->12.6ms), p99 -15%.
Omar: quality?
Ming: 2k quick eval: ppl +0.6, EM -0.8pp, hallucation +1.5pp concentrated in multi-step arithmetic and citation-style facts.
Priya: any pattern over token position?
Ming: errors skew after token 300 where KV compress artifacts show up. also a tiny bias in softmax peakiness on a few heads under q4a.
Omar: mitigation ideas?
Ming: 1) per-layer bias-correction applied to q4a outputs (learned affine from 1k warmup). 2) entity-trigger regex to always route names/numbers to hotpath. 3) lightweight re-rank: keep top-2 candidates from fast-pass and check if reranking by hotpath changes top choice for critical tokens.
Priya: do you have the eval command?
Ming: yes: ./quick_eval --fast /models/nova13b-q4a --slow /models/nova13b-q8 --policy entropy:0.6 --dataset onboard-mini-2k.jsonl --samples 2000 --metrics ppl,exact_match,halluc_rate
Omar: logs?
Ming: s3://redwood-dev/eng-ml/spec-nova/1749999999/run0/
Ming: short table (2k): baseline(q8): ppl 10.9 | EM 75.2% | hall 2.4%; speculative: ppl 11.5 | EM 74.4% | hall 3.9%
Priya: plan?
Ming: run 10k sweep tomorrow with: (a) per-layer affine on/off, (b) top2 fast-pass rerank, (c) entity-forcing. then canary 3% with auto-rollback if hall_rate +1pp.
ops-bot: Canary launch scheduled: spec-decoder-v0.3 -> 3% on dedicated-us-east pool.
Omar: good. can someone spot-check 150 failure examples when the sweep completes?
Priya: I can do 100, ping me the filtered subset.
Ming: will post artifacts + the failure list in this thread. thanks everyone.
